New PMJ 2027 US & Canada Spring Tour Tix: http://pmjtour.com 
Here’s another live performance from our concert at London’s Royal Albert Hall: Rogelio “Triple Threat” Douglas, Jr. has been bringing his incredible vocals, impeccable showmanship, and “Old Soul” stylings to PMJ stages around the world for years — now see him in front of a sold-out crowd at one of the world’s most prestigious venues, performing the PMJ version of "Radioactive" by Imagine Dragons.

Watch our PMJ Studios version of "Radioactive" with Rogelio: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YDVKUz338b4

Watch our original cover of “Radioactive” by Imagine Dragons feat. Blake Lewis here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RCWBxxEJiGc
